title: [Master]-Repeated partial return posting reuses first credit memo and corrupts original order quantities
summary: Fixed repeated partial return postings that were incorrectly reusing the first credit memo and corrupting original order quantities. The fix ensures each posting uses the current credit memo to update order quantities correctly.
key_points: Repeated partial returns were reusing the first credit memo instead of the latest one
This caused original sales order quantities to be corrupted incorrectly
Solution uses the current posting's credit memo from a global variable to update quantities
Fix applied across Sales-Post codeunit in all localization layers
New test cases added to validate the correction
quote: Use the current posting's credit memo to update order quantities correctly from global variable
